safety.archive_semantics: canonical previous/current/next demand archive with exact source-year and DST fallbacks
safety.checkpoint_semantics: one aligned interval before closure; each road must still derive a route-safe warm point and exact cache identity
safety.fallback: cold on any miss, drift, unsafe boundary or failed proof
safety.population_strategy: ordered_candidate_free_prefix_chain_v1; bootstrap the first checkpoint per demand/seed/variant and extend every later checkpoint with exact unfinished-tripinfo reconciliation
